result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a faded marked crosswalk. However, the environment lacks ADA-compliant curb ramps and has poor sightlines due to parked vehicles near the corner.

hazards.name: Lack of curb ramps
hazards.description: The absence of sloped curb transitions at the crossing point creates a barrier for pedestrians with mobility impairments or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: At the corner of the sidewalk where it meets the street crossing.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk paint is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb of the main street near the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install concrete curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using a continental or ladder pattern to increase visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While sidewalks are present, the wide, unmarked roadway and sightline obstructions from parked vehicles and mature trees create a higher-risk environment for people crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross the wide roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground intersection area

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and large trees near the corners block sightlines between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection where cars are parked under the tree

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance, slow turning traffic, and improve visibility by moving pedestrians past the line of parked cars.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with row houses that lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure, specifically sidewalks on the side of the dwellings. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles, and the pavement surface is in poor condition with significant cracking.

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalks
hazards.description: There is no dedicated pedestrian walkway on the right side of the street, forcing people to walk in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway adjacent to the row houses

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Extensive cracking and deterioration of the asphalt surface create trip hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground roadway surface

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb line can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right curb where the white van and red car are parked

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Roadway Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and repave the street to eliminate cracks and provide a smooth, safe walking and driving surface.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing faint crosswalk with high-visibility continental markings to better alert drivers to pedestrian crossing points.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street with a marked ladder-style crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the crossing lacks active traffic control and visibility is partially hindered by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the crosswalk limit the visibility between approaching drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.
